limitations: Classes are inferred from the pinned collector state machine, not independent proof of the stored repository rowset
An empty successful refresh can retain older rows because deletion runs only when seen_repo_ids is nonempty (database.py:115-120)
last_updated is shared by discovery, profile and link stages and by sentinels; it is not a repository retrieval timestamp
An all-default empty profile can represent either a failed profile request or a genuine empty profile; masking is conservative

results.audit_scope: Released minimized export diagnostics; classification and profile availability use persisted ledgers

collector_semantics.classification_basis: Code-inferred fetch outcome, not independent certification of current stored row-set completeness
collector_semantics.empty_refresh_caveat: update_user_repositories deletes obsolete rows only for a nonempty fetched list; a successful empty refresh can retain old rows
collector_semantics.execution_history_caveat: Provider identifies this collector; exact commands and logs still need confirmation

results.fetched_flag_interpretation: Raw flag only; not proof of pagination completion or failure

h_agreement.complete_counter_scope: Declared complete labels, whether collector-inferred or explicit sidecar
h_agreement.eligibility_note: Source diagnostics only; code-inferred completion is not publication eligibility
h_agreement.equivalence: h_observed=h_stored iff at least h_stored repository rows have stars>=h_stored and at most h_stored have stars>=h_stored+1; requires valid nonnegative integer counts
h_agreement.preconditions: Unique account ids; certificate counts the stored repository rows, not independent repository coverage

profile_quality.policy: Mask unprocessed bio-NULL and ambiguous all-default profiles; keep raw values unchanged. This signature can also match a genuine empty profile, so it is conservative missingness inference, not proof of a specific API failure
profile_quality.sponsors_count: Hardcoded zero in fetch_user_profile.py:65; not an observed sponsorship count

results.retrieval_class_inference_basis: Persisted released account classification ledger; not independent rowset certification
results.timestamp_semantics_basis: Pinned collector write paths, conditional on provider-identified execution history; no repository observation timestamp available

repositories.created_at.daily_count_semantics: Calendar date as recorded; no timezone or collection-stage meaning inferred
repositories.created_at.semantics: GitHub repository createdAt retained on insertion, not fetch time (github_parser.py:30-34; database.py:94-105)

users.created_at.daily_count_semantics: Calendar date as recorded; no timezone or collection-stage meaning inferred
users.created_at.semantics: Discovery insertion datetime.now(), not GitHub registration (popular_users.py:168-176)

users.last_updated.daily_count_semantics: Calendar date as recorded; no timezone or collection-stage meaning inferred
users.last_updated.semantics: Overloaded: user refresh/profile-enrichment time or failure sentinel, with parse_all reset; not repository observation time (database.py:41-67,243-252; fetch_user_profile.py:115-145; main.py:89-99)
